run_spherical_joint_simulation: run the pybullet spherical joint limit simulation with a humanoid URDF model in GUI mode
load_urdf_humanoid: load a humanoid URDF model with spherical joint limits into the pybullet physics simulator
set_joint_motor_control: set joint motor control for spherical and prismatic joints using position control mode
configure_gravity_parameters: configure interactive gravity parameters using pybullet debug sliders for x, y, and z axes
reset_joint_states: reset multi-dof joint states for spherical, prismatic, and revolute joints to initial positions
